notes: Curated datasets are intentionally selective evidence syntheses. A reconciled contract means every included row has traceable provenance and the selection claim is explicit; it does not mean the file contains every real-world entity of that class.

contracts.selection_policy: Represent the source-listed NSW declared REZs, Victoria 2025 proposed REZs, and Queensland 2024 potential REZs relevant to the inherited/planned east-coast energy geography while preserving their different dates and status semantics.
contracts.completeness_test: Within the named source families: NSW 5/5; Victoria 6/6; Queensland historical roadmap 12/12. This is not a generator, substation or current Queensland energy-hub inventory.

contracts.selection_policy: Retain high-consequence physical/engineering constraints found in reviewed HSR and conventional-rail studies that materially inform corridor-cost reasoning.
contracts.completeness_test: Every included obstacle must cite a primary study/evaluation. No claim that every obstacle in every study is extracted.

contracts.selection_policy: Track major Australian east-coast HSR study generations and current HSRA work needed to understand evidence lineage, assumptions and policy evolution.
contracts.completeness_test: Every listed study has a source URL; the file is a major-study bibliography, not a claim that every historic paper/proposal mentioning HSR is present.

contracts.selection_policy: Extract decision-relevant quantitative and qualitative findings from reviewed HSR studies, including cost, travel time, engineering and settlement-policy evidence.
contracts.completeness_test: Every evidence row must identify the study and source URL. No claim to reproduce every metric in each study.

contracts.selection_policy: Retain major recent, completed, committed or under-construction east-coast projects that illustrate inherited capital and path dependency at VECA scale.
contracts.completeness_test: Every row must resolve to a primary project/program source and preserve value scope/status. This is not the complete Australian infrastructure pipeline.

contracts.selection_policy: Track strategic intermodal/freight nodes already encountered in VECA corridor research where rail-road-port interfaces materially affect regional optionality.
contracts.completeness_test: Every included node must have a direct authority/operator source. No claim of national terminal completeness until a separate operator/authority census is built.

contracts.selection_policy: Retain transport metrics directly useful to whole-system comparison, including capacity, utilisation, freight/passenger performance and cost evidence where sourced.
contracts.completeness_test: Each metric must preserve source and definition. No claim that all transport KPIs are represented.

contracts.selection_policy: Track high-consequence health, education, government-land and related regional anchors in the currently studied VECA regions.
contracts.completeness_test: Every included asset must be directly sourced. This is an anchor set, not a catalogue of all public assets.

contracts.selection_policy: Track major university, TAFE and VET institutions/campuses that materially contribute to skills and knowledge capacity in the studied regional centres.
contracts.completeness_test: Every included asset has a provider/government source URL. Not an exhaustive inventory of every campus, school or training provider.

contracts.selection_policy: Retain government-owned/development land and education assets where land control or institutional capital creates future settlement optionality.
contracts.completeness_test: Included rows require direct provenance and explicit asset class. No claim of complete Crown/government land ownership coverage.

contracts.selection_policy: Track health capital programs and masterplans that expose relocation, renewal or long-horizon expansion choices relevant to VECA.
contracts.completeness_test: Every row resolves to a canonical health plan/project source. Not an exhaustive hospital-capital program census.

contracts.selection_policy: Capture health-capital and service-planning signals that reveal fixed versus flexible future investment across currently studied regions.
contracts.completeness_test: Every included signal must have traceable source provenance. No claim of every health project or budget line.

contracts.selection_policy: Track planning mechanisms, future growth areas, zoning/target frameworks and conservation pre-clearance that materially preserve or constrain settlement options.
contracts.completeness_test: Every row resolves to a statutory/strategic planning source. Not a parcel-level zoning census.

contracts.selection_policy: Capture official growth assumptions for the regional-plan geographies currently selected for VECA comparison, including retained legacy Victorian plans where current statewide planning supersedes but does not erase historical intent.
contracts.completeness_test: Each currently scoped regional baseline row resolves to its plan. Completeness is against the named VECA comparison regions, not every Australian regional plan.

contracts.selection_policy: Track major regional hospital/health anchors whose current or committed capital materially affects settlement inheritance in studied regions.
contracts.completeness_test: Every included asset resolves to one or more primary health sources. Not an exhaustive health-facility inventory.

contracts.selection_policy: Extract decision-relevant assumptions from reviewed regional plans, especially population, housing, centre hierarchy, infrastructure sequencing and growth geography.
contracts.completeness_test: Every assumption must cite its source plan. No claim to reproduce every statement in each plan.

contracts.selection_policy: Track new-school, expansion, reservation and growth signals that reveal where governments expect substantial settlement growth.
contracts.completeness_test: Each signal has a government/education source. Explicitly not an inventory of all existing schools.

contracts.selection_policy: Track major industrial/logistics precincts where public enabling infrastructure and private investment jointly create regional economic gravity.
contracts.completeness_test: Every row resolves to all cited program/project sources. No claim of complete industrial-estate coverage.

contracts.selection_policy: Represent major functional water systems encountered in current VECA regions, preserving source, storage, treatment, transfer and augmentation distinctions where known.
contracts.completeness_test: Every system row resolves to utility/authority sources. Geographic gaps remain an explicit research backlog; the set does not claim all east-coast water systems are present.

contracts.selection_policy: Retain only as historical project-state evidence while canonical government-intent datasets are migrated.
contracts.completeness_test: No completeness claim. Must not receive new data or be treated as canonical map input.

contracts.selection_policy: Retain only as historical project-state evidence while canonical domains/government-intent data supersedes it.
contracts.completeness_test: No completeness claim. Must not receive new data or be treated as canonical map input.
